notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
05.01.2021 - Update 1.0.3

Several revisions and bug fixings have been made on this 1.0.3 version of Spinodrum.

Revisions:
-Training Module in How To panel, is polished through fixing overlapping issues between partition playbacks.
-How To panel is revisioned with detailed images.
-Customization message boxes now have backgrounds to read much better.

Fixed Bugs:
-Z Index problem between customization messages (for both skin and scene changes) and equipment names (RMB) is fixed now.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
31.12.2020 - Update 1.0.2

New implementations, several bug fixes and performance improvements have been made on this 1.0.2 version of Spinodrum.

Additions:
-TRAINING MODULE implemented under the HOW TO panel with 12 built-in and pre-recorded short partitions. Users are able to listen and practice with this system. It can be found by clicking the question mark on interface.
-Detailed Keymap now has small preview icons which shows the equipment of clicked key.

Performance Improvements:
-Various performance improvements have been made for older machines. 

Fixed Bugs:
-A sound problem caused by ending of cowbell, now fixed.
-Live Recorder warning light in Studio was affecting the ambient of both Garage and Customizable scenes. This problem is fixed now.

***IMPORTANT NOTICE: This is some kind of a major update. So, please be sure that you take a backup of your customized files from installation folder before update Spinodrum to prevent possible replacements.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Several bug fixes have been made on this 1.0.1 version of Spinodrum.

Fixed bugs:
	-Pressing TAB key at the beginning was causing an unnecessary sound.
	-Trying to hide the left menu bar were causing to hide "Live Keymap" while "Return to Main Menu" or "Beat Creator" windows were open.
